Module for merging overlapping half-open intervals.

This module provides functionality to take a list of half-open intervals 
[start, end) and merge any overlapping or adjacent intervals into a single 
continuous range.

Half-open intervals are defined such that the start point is included, 
but the end point is excluded (e.g., [1, 2) includes 1 but not 2).
"""

from typing import List, Tuple, Optional
from copy import deepcopy
